I'm Husain from Milan, Italy. I grew up bilingual, speaking English and Arabic and learned Italian as an adult—on iTalki! Now I live in Italy and speak it fluently.

• You can choose structured lessons with clear goals or casual conversation practice—it’s up to you!
• I teach all levels, from beginners to advanced speakers.
• My lessons focus on real conversation, so you learn the way people actually speak.
• Relaxed, supportive environment where you can speak without fear of making mistakes. 
• I'm passionate about music, cinema, art and languages.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
• I use my own language-learning journey to make lessons engaging, practical, and suited to real-life situations.

• My approach is adaptable: every student is different, so I adjust my methods based on your needs and learning style.

• I believe in creating a comfortable learning environment where you can make mistakes without pressure.

• LGBTQIA+ and neurodivergent safe space
teacher_info.teaching_style:
• My lessons are conversation-based; you’ll learn by speaking as much as possible in real situations.

• You can choose structured lessons, where we follow a clear plan, or more free-flowing conversations based on your interests.

• If you want to focus on grammar, we can have grammar lessons where I’ll break it down simply and clearly.

• If you prefer expanding your vocabulary and improving pronunciation, we can focus on real-life topics and practical expressions.

• I encourage speaking as much as possible, but I will always guide and support you if you feel stuck.

course_info.trial_description:
In this trial lesson, we will:
✅ Introduce ourselves – A quick chat to get to know each other.
✅ Discuss your goals & preferences – Tell me about your learning style, expectations, and what you’d like to focus on.
✅ Experience a mini-lesson – A short demo of how a regular lesson would go, while playing the desert island game. 
✅ Answer any questions – Feel free to ask anything about the lessons or my teaching approach.

Durante la lezione di prova:
✅ Ci presenteremo – Una breve chiacchierata per conoscerci meglio.
✅ Discuteremo i tuoi obiettivi e preferenze – Parlami del tuo stile di apprendimento, delle tue aspettative e di ciò su cui vorresti concentrarti.
✅ Facciamo una mini-lezione – Una breve dimostrazione di come si svolgerebbe una lezione normale, giocando al gioco "desert island" 
✅ Risponderò a tutte le tue domande – Chiedimi qualsiasi cosa sulle lezioni o sul mio metodo di insegnamento.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I am a trained teacher of English language and Literature with over 15 years experience in classroom teaching and instruction and  3 years experience as an online teacher of English and Swahili languages for kids, teens and adults. I am a patient, creative and understanding teacher. I use learner centered approach in all my lessons that enables you to learn at your own pace from known to unknown, one lesson at a time. See you in my class soon. Thank you.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I purpose to create a customized fun learning environment that suits the individual needs of all my learners regardless of their age, background and language learning level in either English or Swahili. I achieve this by using real life scenario-based conversation practice, reading comprehension, pronunciation drills, report writing, grammar and vocabulary practice among others. My overall objective is making you a confident, competent and fluent speaker of either English or Swahili language from Foundational/Beginner Level (A1) all the way to Proficiency Level (C2), one lesson at a time. Book a trial lesson with me today and let’s get started. Thank you for viewing my teaching profile.

course_info.trial_description: Hello, in this lesson, I will get a better understanding of your learning needs as you also find out about me and my teaching style. The objective of this lesson is to formulate an individualized learning plan that is tailor made to propel you in achieving your learning goals in English or Swahili; from beginner to advanced level. I am looking forward to meeting you in class.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description: I will help you to understand and use frequently used everyday expressions as well as simple phrases to meet immediate needs. Learn to introduce yourself and others, ask and answer questions about personal details for example where you live, people you know and many others.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic Swahili for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description: I will assist you to learn the basic and commonly used simple words, phrases and sentences in Swahili for greetings, introducing yourself and others, naming things and so on. Karibu. (Welcome)

pro_course_detail.title: English for Kids
pro_course_detail.description: In this lesson, kids of ages 6-18 years old interested in learning English get to build their confidence in reading, listening and speaking practice while constructing simple, complete and correct sentences from beginner level to advanced level. Kindly note that 5 minutes shall be slotted for teacher-parent conference at the tail end of the lesson to provide learner progress report.

pro_course_detail.title: General Conversation Practice - Includes a 10 Lesson package for All Levels  at a DISCOUNT!
pro_course_detail.description: In this lesson, you will strengthen your English listening and speaking skills that you need in daily communication using real life scenario based conversation practice sessions on common topics of your choice. The conversations range from basic to advanced levels. Let's meet in class soon!

pro_course_detail.title: Swahili Conversation Practice - Take advantage of the 10 Lessons Package at a GREAT DISCOUNT!
pro_course_detail.description: Learn how to communicate in Swahili language both in formal and informal contexts through interactive conversation practice based on general discussion topics of your choice. Karibu darasani!

pro_course_detail.title: Swahili Grammar/Sarufi
pro_course_detail.description: Learn the 8 Swahili Noun Classes and how to use them in sentences with different tenses. Practice will be done using exercises and general conversation practice based on topics of your choice.
